items.name: DeepInfer
items.description: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models

readme.excerpt:
DeepInfer is the high-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This open-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale.

- Optimized kernels, model and sampler runtime - Parallelism: Attention DP / balanced CP, MoE EP + EPLB - DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification - SWA bounded replay - Asynchronous scheduling (zero-overhead batch scheduler) - Batch-invariant inference - Deterministic sampling - Structured outputs

- Optimized kernels: FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, DeepEP, TileKernels, DeepSelect, and custom TileLang kernels. - DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification: accelerate decoding with draft tokens and use confidence estimates to schedule verification. Set DEEPINFER ENABLE MTP VARLEN=1 ; DEEPINFER USE NEXTN DECODE controls the maximum draft length (default: 5). - Decoder SWA bounded replay: reduce decoder prefill work by replaying only a bounded suffix. Set DEEPINFER YOCO PREFILL TRUNCATION MODE=compact and DEEPINFER YOCO PREFILL KEEP TOKENS=140 for the default V4.1 settings; the retained suffix must cover the SWA window plus the maximum backtracking length. - Asynchronous scheduling: overlap CPU batch scheduling with device execution. Enabled by default. - Batch-invariant inference: keep model results identical across different batch compositions. Enable with DEEPINFER BATCH INVARIANT=1 (NVIDIA only). - Deterministic sampling: produce identical outputs for identical input t

items.name: ponytail
items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

readme.excerpt:
Ponytail 5: rebuilt from the ground up. -53% code · -41% time · -26% cost · -45% tokens And yet: 98% of risky logic ships with a test. Without Ponytail: 68%. Benchmarked in Claude Code, the same agent with and without the skill: 39 tasks including a real FastAPI + React repo, Opus 5.5, 5 runs each. Details .

You know him. Long ponytail. Oval glasses. Has been at the company longer than the version control. You show him fifty lines; he looks at them, says nothing, and replaces them with one.

Two things the chart does not show: in a blind comparison, Ponytail 5's replies beat the previous Ponytail's 110 to 67. And on the six security tasks (SQL injection, path traversal, forged tokens, rate limiting, malformed CSV rows, caching) it passed all 30 runs: less code, no less safe. Method, per-task tables and limits: benchmarks/results/2026-10-07-agentic.md.

Desktop apps in Go, with native UI or a web frontend.

Each MyGo window shows one of two kinds of interface, and one app, or one window, can mix them:

items.name: duckdb
items.description: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system

readme.excerpt:
DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system. It is designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. DuckDB runs in-process inside your application, so there is no separate server to manage and no external dependencies. It can also read remote files, query other databases, and connect to other DuckDB instances when needed. It provides a rich SQL dialect with support far beyond basic SQL: arbitrary and nested correlated subqueries, window functions, collations, and complex types (arrays, structs, maps). Its friendly SQL extensions add syntax that makes queries shorter and easier to write.

DuckDB is available as a standalone CLI application and has clients for Python, R, Java, Rust, Go, Wasm, and many more, with deep integrations with packages such as pandas.

For more information on using DuckDB, please refer to the DuckDB documentation.

items.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

readme.excerpt:
Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started.

It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff.

A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers ( 1,505 annotated ground-truth issues).
